tools.name: lsp_diagnostics
tools.description: Language-server diagnostics for a workspace file. Starts/reuses the server for the file's language (gopls, typescript-language-server, pyright-langserver, rust-analyzer), opens the file from disk, and waits for a diagnostics publish. Reports saved content only.

path.description: Workspace-relative path of the file to check

wait_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait for diagnostics to arrive (default 3000, max 15000)

tools.name: lsp_definition
tools.description: Go to the definition of the symbol at a 1-based line/column in a workspace file.

tools.name: lsp_references
tools.description: Find references to the symbol at a 1-based line/column in a workspace file.

include_declaration.description: Also report the declaration itself (default false)

tools.name: lsp_symbols
tools.description: List the symbols (functions, types, methods, ...) defined in a workspace file.

tools.name: lsp_rename
tools.description: Rename the symbol at a 1-based line/column across the workspace. Rewrites affected files in place (write approval applies).

path.description: Workspace-relative path of the file containing the symbol
